Truly Knowing, everything in Everything
And from Everything every thing falls,
It suffices to say that knowing the One
Is the Knowing of All
Awakened understanding is always a no brainer
Simply said; comes Knowing's call.
So gently does Truth there reign,
The ambrosial rememberence of leaves in the Fall.
